nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Stop there. Whoever you are, that thing you carry. Off.
Light, radio, anything that hums. Off, or go back the way you came.

choices.text: It's a battery. I can't switch it off.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You've brought something that hums. I can hear it from here.
Shut it off, or take it out past the mud.

choices.text: It's a battery. I can't switch it off.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Better. Now. Let me look at you.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Better. Thank you. Sit, if you want.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Then put it down somewhere past the mud, and come back without it.
I mean it. Not here.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Then it's in you. That happens, near the stones.
Sit somewhere away from them until it fades. Then come back.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Don't come any closer. Not yet.
Let me look at you.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: No bow. No spear. Salt in your hair.
Off a boat, then. Like me, a long time ago.

choices.text: Is there a way off this island?
Are they going to kill me?

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Marek. It's the only name I use now.
I came ashore before you were born. They let me stay. I stopped asking why.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: There are ways. I don't use them.
Listen first. Or you won't live long enough to find one.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Maybe. They warn first, most times.
An arrow in the sand at your feet means go back. So you go back.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Two things. Remember them.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The reef, to the north-east. At low water you can walk it to the wreck.
At high water it takes you. It doesn't give anything back.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: And metal. Anything that hums, or clicks, or shines.
Near their paths, put it away. They hate it. Or the island does.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: I stopped trying to tell which.

choices.text: Why do they let you live?

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: I don't fully know.
I stay on the mud. I take nothing from the forest. I carry no metal.
I leave fish at the totems, and I don't go where they go. Maybe that's all of it.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: They don't come into the mud. Here, you can sit.
Out there, you can't. Come back when you need to.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You came back.
I thought you might not. I'm glad.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You've been near the stones. It's on you, like smoke.
Sit a while. It fades.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Come in under the roof. Such as it is.
Rain is good. It covers your footsteps. Theirs too.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You walked here in the dark?
Keep low on the way back. The moon shows more than you think.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: The light's turning. The fish come in close now.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Low water. The reef is showing its back.
If you mean to go to the wreck, you're wasting it here.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: High water. Nobody crosses the reef now. Not them, not you.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: You again. Sit, if you want. The mud doesn't mind.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Still alive. Good.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: What is it?

choices.text: About the others who came here.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Ask.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Low now. The reef path is open, all the way to the wreck.
Go now if you're going. It turns faster than you'd think.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Coming in. If you were out on the reef now, you'd already be late.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: High. The reef is under. Don't try it, not even the edge.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Going out. Soon the reef will show its back again.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: A boat goes out on the high water. Over the outer reef, never through it.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: They watch the reef. They watch the beaches.
They warn before they shoot. Respect the warning, and you may live to get another.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: I don't know their words. I've never heard them speak to me.
I know when to sit still. That's all I know.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: To be left alone. That much I'm sure of.
The rest I won't guess at. Guessing is how people like us end up in the roots.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The middle. I call it the Quiet Meridian.
The birds stop there. So does everything else.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The stones hum. Your compass will lie to you.
And the path you came in by is not there when you turn round.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: I went in once. I don't go now.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Nothing. I came out the other side.
Most of me did. Some nights I can still hear it from here.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: It's shorter. If it lets you through.
No light. Nothing that hums. Walk, don't run. Don't trust the path behind you.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Others? A few, over the years. None of them left.
I won't tell their stories for them. Find them first. Then ask me.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Which one?

choices.text: The one with the tent and the maps.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The missionary. He paddled in with a book and a good tarp.
They put two arrows in the palm above his head. A warning.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: He came back. I told him what the arrows meant.
He said he wasn't afraid. He wasn't. It didn't help him.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: I left him where he lay. They don't like the ground opened.
His rope and his tarp are still good. Use them. He won't.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: He meant well. Meaning well is not a shield. Not here.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The sailor. From the freighter on the reef.
She ran aground in a storm. Eighty-one, I think. Or eighty-two.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The crew waited on her deck for weeks, and in the end they were taken off.
He had gone ashore for water. Nobody came back for him.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: He lasted a season. Then he didn't.
He carried a pry bar for the hatches. Always. Even asleep.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: You have it now. Good. That ship might as well be some use to someone.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: If it's still with him, take it. That ship might as well be some use to someone.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: He used to whistle at night, the sailor. Sometimes a whistle came back.
I never knew whether that was a kindness.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The mapmaker. The nineties. He came with a telephone that talked to satellites.
And flares, and a compass, and a great deal of confidence.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: He wanted to measure the middle. Put it on paper.
His phone died the day he arrived. His compass the day after.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: He nailed his map to a stone and walked into the Meridian.
I watched him go. He was humming. I don't think he knew.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: His camp is still there. His flares may still be dry. His map is better than mine.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Some nights I think I hear him humming, out in the middle. I don't go and look.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: What do you need?

choices.text: The hum in my head. How do I quiet it?
How do I get into the wreck?
When I go, come with me.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: So you've started to hear it. Everyone does, sooner or later.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Driftwood from the shore. A length of cord. A bone, or a shell.
Lash them in a cross and carry it with you.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: It quiets the hum. Not all of it. Enough.
I copied the ones at the borders. Why it works, I can't tell you.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Driftwood, cord, a bone or a shell. Lash them. Carry it.
It won't make you quiet. Quieter.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You have the sailor's bar. That opens it.
Go at low water. Be off the reef before the turn.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: The sailor's bar. He's in the roots where the mangroves meet the forest, south-east of here.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: The cabin is sealed. Rusted shut, and the hatch is heavy.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: The sailor from the freighter had a bar for it.
He lies in the roots where the mangroves meet the forest. South-east of here.

nodes.text: Marek looks at the water for a long time.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: I had a life somewhere else. It went on without me. That's as it should be.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: I belong to the quiet meridian now.
It wouldn't let me go. I wouldn't ask it to.

choices.text: A ship will come. There's room for two.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: Go when the water is right. Don't look back for me.
I'll leave a fish at the totem for you. That's how it's done here.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: You asked. I answered. Go well, when you go.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Mind the tide.

choices.text: Here. I brought you a fish.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: A fish. You're learning how things are done here.
I'll take it to the totem tonight. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Thank you. I'll drink to your boat, whatever it turns out to be.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Keep low. Keep dark. Come back if you need to.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Mind the tide.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: You patched it. I can see it on you.
Go on the high water. Over the outer reef, and then don't stop.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: I won't come down to the beach. They'd see two of us.

choices.text: One last time. Come with me.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: No.
Go well.

nodes.speaker: marek
lines: That's a flare pistol. You'll take it up to the ridge.
When it goes up, everyone on this island will see it. Everyone.

nodes.speaker: marek
nodes.text: Fire it, then hold your ground. Don't run for the trees.
